title: p/9 recovery from a reset-sensitive discriminant
statement: For the stated pure-isometry/reset source,H=4T-6omega gives complete error<=eps p+50epsilon_ent from p/9 identity+(1-p/9)erasure,epsilon_ent=sqrt[5(p+3q)Delta], under epsilon_ent<=p/25. Consumed cap131072S²/xi+2Lrm,xi=eps/2; meaningful relative error is small compared with p/9.

requires: Fixed finite-dimensional stationary memoryless source; data/reference and every fresh program independent conditional on ONE fixed source. Known accessible output-register type, trusted qutrit/ancilla gates, coherent whole-register SWAPs and quantum memory. No purification, inverse oracle, hidden flag, unknown eigenbasis or reusable decoder is supplied. Success here is a PURE qutrit isometry; reset tau may coherently overlap its code. p/9 uses H=4T-6omega with repeated spectral acceptance; full p uses all nine Weyl labels, retained-data rejection, coherent QPE uncomputation and the received weighted CQ branch estimates.
provides: For the stated pure-isometry/reset source,H=4T-6omega gives complete error<=eps p+50epsilon_ent from p/9 identity+(1-p/9)erasure,epsilon_ent=sqrt[5(p+3q)Delta], under epsilon_ent<=p/25. Consumed cap131072S²/xi+2Lrm,xi=eps/2; meaningful relative error is small compared with p/9.
assumptions: The p/9 target is p/9 identity+(1-p/9)erasure: eps=nu/2 and Delta<=nu²p²/[50000(p+3q)] suffice for error<=nu p. Always-erasure already has error2p/9, so useful nu must be smaller. Full-p target is p identity+q erasure: xi=nu/74 and Delta<=nu²p²/[7840800000(p+3q)] suffice. Its large constant remains explicit. A false transported-projector inequality is NOT a premise; the source-CQ/ideal-prefix/actual-suffix proof is essential. Unrestricted WH3 entropy/VALUE and general mixed-success recovery remain OPEN. These conditional model theorems do not verify source promises, stationarity, Delta, hardware, novelty, advantage, unassisted capacity or finite-block coding.
costs: Charge every fresh training program, forward/reverse simulation, rejected/early-stop branches, original noisy datum (+1 call), validation/startup, preparation, holding/memory and classical processing. Gate width/storage depend on output dimension even when sample count does not. Each datum consumes a new bank; no free batching or demonstrated practical advantage. p/9 cap131072 S²/xi+2Lrm,xi=eps/2,S=Lr pi(M-1)/2. Full-p cap2*10^9 S²/xi+36Lrm,S=9Lr pi(M-1). Each manuscript has its own explicit L,eta,M,r allocation; their S and accuracy symbols differ.
contract.units: UNHALVED diamond norm; probabilities/deficits dimensionless. Natural logs except explicit log2/hash rates. Budgets retain source-local time/accuracy parameters.
